module: MCP performance tools: metrics of the last frame, FPS limiter reason, VRAM usage, and Optick profiler captures (BNG_PROFILER=OPTICK builds only).
notes: profiler_run is non-blocking: a job (core_jobsystem) waits delay then captures for duration seconds then saves the .opt; only one at a time ("already running").
Output path: by default <user folder>/optick/optick_YYYY-MM-DD_HH-MM-SS.opt; a relative path is placed under optick/; an absolute path (drive or UNC) is used as is.

get_performance_metrics.desc: Metrics of the last frame (timings, memory, counters) via Engine.Debug.getLastPerformanceMetrics, as JSON.

returns.desc: JSON (empty object if the API is missing).

get_fps_limit_reason.desc: Current sources and caps of the FPS limiter (vsync, foreground/background limits, focus), via Engine.getCurrentFpsLimitReason.

returns.desc: JSON (or tostring if it is not a table).

profiler_run.desc: Triggers an Optick capture of `duration` seconds after `delay` and saves a .opt file; returns its path and the availability delay.

args.desc: {duration?: number s (default 5), delay?: number s (default 0), path?: string}

returns.desc: JSON {ok, path, duration, delay, readyInSeconds, note} or error.

run_optick_ui.desc: Launches the external Optick interface (like the Ctrl+Alt+O shortcut) by calling the global function launchOptick if it exists.
